steps.talk.body: Request an introduction. Share your goals, ask your questions, and bring a parent along.

faq.parents.a: Absolutely. Parents are welcome, especially for university pathway planning, destination guidance and younger students.
faq.countries.a: Families in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman. Online tutors list the Gulf countries they teach, and in-person tutors show their city. Use “Where are you based?” to see who serves you.
faq.counseling.a: Educational guidance on study destinations, degree choices and university pathways, informed by each counselor’s own study experience. It is not official admissions, legal, visa or immigration advice.
faq.booking.q: How do I book a session?
faq.booking.a: Choose a specialist and prepare an introduction request with your goals and student level. Tutorcat’s contact email is awaiting setup, so requests can currently be copied or opened as email drafts.
faq.booking.aReady: Choose a specialist and prepare an introduction request with your goals and student level. It opens as an email draft you can check before sending.
